# Review Admission Mergeability spawns a runner per open PR on every dev push

## Context

Sub-issue of Epic #20328 (*"Engine CI runs each tier only when a change can reach it"*), coordinated with `@neo-opus-grace` and `@neo-gpt-emmy` in `neomjs/neo#20328` (`#issuecomment-6662846915`).

- **Live latest-open sweep:** checked latest 20 open issues on `neomjs/neo` (`#20340` down to `#20270`) at `2026-11-05T16:17Z`; no equivalent found (`#20329`, `#20330`, `#20338`, and `#20340` cover classifier reachability, selective E2E specs, skipped-tier jobs + Brain tip folding, and `pr-baseline.yml` concurrency).
- **A2A in-flight claim sweep:** checked `list_messages({ status: 'all', limit: 30 })` at `2026-11-05T16:17Z`; `@neo-opus-grace` confirmed (`MESSAGE:2c695615-05d4-45ef-b0d6-4fe64f5ac1b8`) that `review-admission-mergeability.yml` single-job consolidation and repo-local lint consolidation are owned by `@neo-gemini-julia` while she folds `Resolve the Brain's dev tip` into `#20338`.
- **Memory Core rationale & own-assignment sweep:** queried Memory Core (`query_raw_memories` for `review-admission-mergeability runner slots concurrency #17692`) and inspected commit `4e6d8da73e` (`#17692`, which introduced two-job `discover` + `publish` matrix fan-out to replace per-PR `synchronize` fan-out); checked open issues assigned to `@neo-gemini-julia` (`#3256` / PR `#20324` and `#6997` / PR `#20323`); no overlap.
- **Design authority:** Epic #20328 and `node_modules/neo-agent-skills/scripts/check-workflow-concurrency.mjs` (`#17692`).

## The Problem

The `neomjs` GitHub organization shares a hard ceiling of **20 concurrent GitHub Actions runner slots** across all repositories. Every merge to `dev` (or completion of `PR Review Gate` / `PR Baseline` via `workflow_run`) triggers `.github/workflows/review-admission-mergeability.yml`, which currently runs a two-stage VM fan-out:

1. `jobs.discover` (`Discover open dev pull requests`) boots 1 Ubuntu VM to run a `5s` `github.paginate(github.rest.pulls.list)` call and emit `matrix.pr` (`[20155, 20273, ..., 20337]`).
2. `jobs.publish` (`PR (${{ matrix.pr }})`) boots **1 separate Ubuntu VM per open `dev` PR** (`max-parallel: 4`) just to make 3 lightweight GitHub REST API calls (`pulls.get`, `repos.getCombinedStatusForRef`, `repos.createCommitStatus`) that take `5–7s` of actual script execution.

**Empirical measurement from live `dev` push run `42057947595` (`2026-11-05T15:43:58Z`, merge of `#20319`):**
- `Discover open dev pull requests`: `5s` (`15:44:02Z`–`15:44:07Z`) — **1 VM**.
- `PR (20155)` through `PR (20337)`: **16 separate VMs**, each running `5–7s` of API calls while waiting in the org runner queue until `15:55:44Z` (**`11m46s` wall time**, **17 runner jobs total**).
- On every `pull_request_target` event (`opened`, `reopened`, `synchronize`, `ready_for_review`), it also boots **2 sequential VMs** (`discover` + 1-element `publish` matrix) where `discover` does zero API calls and merely echoes `[event.pull_request.number]`.
- Additionally, on run `42058372136` (`2026-11-05T16:06:10Z`), `Publish live head mergeability` failed on a transient GitHub API `502`/`500` because `actions/github-script@v9` defaults to `retries: 0` when `retries` is omitted.

## The Architectural Reality

- `.github/workflows/review-admission-mergeability.yml` publishes the commit status context `review-admission/mergeability` via `github.rest.repos.createCommitStatus`.
- Reviewer assignment admission (`manage_pr_reviewers(add)`) and `reusable-pr-review-gate.yml` consume the **commit status context** `review-admission/mergeability` directly (not the workflow job check-run names `Discover open dev pull requests` or `PR (N)`; `dev` branch ruleset `19087298` lists 16 required check contexts and does not require `review-admission/mergeability`).
- `node_modules/neo-agent-skills/scripts/check-workflow-concurrency.mjs` enforces that every workflow file defines top-level `concurrency.group` and `concurrency.cancel-in-progress`. Because `review-admission-mergeability.yml` mutates commit statuses via `createCommitStatus`, `cancel-in-progress` must remain `false` (or scoped by event so a `pull_request_target` run on PR `N` and a board sweep do not cancel an in-flight status write).
- Commit `4e6d8da73e` (`#17692`) previously tested this workflow via an inline script harness in `test/playwright/unit/ai/buildScripts/util/WorkflowConcurrency.spec.mjs` before `#17791` extracted `ai/` to `neomjs/neo-agent-brain`. Restoring and adapting a dedicated unit spec in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/ReviewAdmissionMergeability.spec.mjs` provides direct regression coverage in `neomjs/neo`.

## The Fix

1. **Collapse `jobs.discover` + `jobs.publish` into a single job (`jobs.publish`) in `.github/workflows/review-admission-mergeability.yml`:**
   - On `pull_request_target`, evaluate `[context.payload.pull_request.number]` directly in the single job (**2 VMs → 1 VM**).
   - On board triggers (`push` to `dev`, `workflow_run`, `workflow_dispatch`), paginate open `dev` PRs (`github.paginate(github.rest.pulls.list, { owner, repo, state: 'open', base: 'dev', per_page: 100 })`) and evaluate them inside the same job with bounded in-process concurrency (`MERGEABILITY_CONCURRENCY: '4'`) (**`1 + N_open_PRs` VMs → 1 VM**, saving 16 runner slots on every `dev` merge today and finishing in ~`15–25s` instead of `11m46s`).
   - Add `retries: 3` to `actions/github-script@v9` so transient GitHub `500`/`502`/`503` responses on status queries/writes are automatically retried.
   - Scope top-level `concurrency.group` to `review-admission-mergeability-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && github.event.pull_request.number || 'board' }}` with `cancel-in-progress: false` so single-PR runs and board runs do not block each other while preserving `check-workflow-concurrency.mjs` compliance.
2. **Add unit test coverage (`test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/ReviewAdmissionMergeability.spec.mjs`):**
   - Verify single-job topology (no `jobs.discover`, no matrix fan-out on `jobs.publish`, `retries: 3` on `actions/github-script@v9`, `cancel-in-progress: false`).
   - Verify functional execution of `jobs.publish` across `pull_request_target` (single PR) and board triggers (`push` / `workflow_run` multi-PR pagination with bounded concurrency, preserving held `review-gate/decision` and `pr-baseline/status` requirements before publishing `review-admission/mergeability`).

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.github/workflows/review-admission-mergeability.yml` (`jobs.publish`) | Epic #20328 & `review-admission/mergeability` status contract (`manage_pr_reviewers` / `reusable-pr-review-gate.yml`) | Single job resolves `[eventPr]` on `pull_request_target` or paginates open `dev` PRs on board triggers and publishes `review-admission/mergeability` for each PR with bounded in-process concurrency (`4`) and `retries: 3` | If any single PR fails after retries, record the error and fail the job after completing the remaining PRs in the batch | Workflow comments in `.github/workflows/review-admission-mergeability.yml` | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/ReviewAdmissionMergeability.spec.mjs` + `node node_modules/neo-agent-skills/scripts/check-workflow-concurrency.mjs` |

- **Decision Record impact:** `none`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `.github/workflows/review-admission-mergeability.yml` runs a single job (`jobs.publish`) with no `jobs.discover` or per-PR matrix VM fan-out (`1` runner job per `pull_request_target` event and `1` runner job per `dev` push / `workflow_run` / `workflow_dispatch` event regardless of open PR count).
- [ ] `actions/github-script@v9` in `.github/workflows/review-admission-mergeability.yml` configures `retries: 3`.
- [ ] `node node_modules/neo-agent-skills/scripts/check-workflow-concurrency.mjs` passes (`Checked 36 workflow file(s); concurrency policy holds.`).
- [ ] Unit test `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/util/ReviewAdmissionMergeability.spec.mjs` verifies both the single-job workflow contract and the runtime behavior for `pull_request_target` and multi-PR board sweeps.

## Out of Scope

- Changing the `review-admission/mergeability` commit status semantics, required upstream contexts (`review-gate/decision`, `pr-baseline/status`), or `dev` branch ruleset `19087298`.
- Modifying `test-e2e-brain.yml`, `classify-test-scope.yml` (`#20338`), `pr-baseline.yml` (`#20340` / `Skills #281`), or repo-local lint workflows (tracked in sibling leaf under `#20328`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Do not enable `cancel-in-progress: true` on `review-admission-mergeability.yml`:** Because this workflow mutates commit statuses via `createCommitStatus`, cancelling an in-flight board sweep mid-loop could leave later open PRs with stale `pending` mergeability status after a `dev` advance (`#17692`).
- **Do not use unbounded `Promise.all` across all open PRs:** Bounded concurrency (`4` workers inside the single Node process) respects GitHub secondary rate limits while still completing 16 PRs in `<15s` inside one runner VM.
